info.title: Tidefern API
info.description: Versioned REST contract for every Tidefern client. Health data travels only in request and response bodies, never in paths or query strings.

servers.description: Same origin as the web app

profile.description: The profile summary, or null until onboarding creates the profile

guardianOf.description: Children this actor is a guardian of

grants.description: Active grants where this actor is the grantee

authenticatedAt.description: When this session was created by signing in

timeZone.description: IANA time zone every calendar fact is read in

childId.description: The one child a child grant reaches

id.description: Optional client-minted UUIDv7 for offline-first clients

inviteeEmail.description: The address the invitation is bound to; acceptance needs a sign-in with it

joined.description: False when the invitee chose to stay in her current household

householdId.description: The household joined, or null when not joined

household.description: Required on the second call when the invitee already belongs to another household: move leaves it, stay keeps it and declines to join

role.description: Her role in the household shared with the actor

householdId.description: The household shared with the actor, if any

guardianOf.description: Children of the actor's that this person also guards

grants.description: Active grants from the actor to this person

notify.description: The per-person notification switch; true when any grant has it

version.description: Changes with every grant change for this person; the value If-Match compares

SharingPerson.description: One person and what the actor shares with her

childId.description: The one child a child grant reaches

notify.description: Whether this person is told when a period starts

SharingGrant.description: A category the actor shares with one person

policyVersion.description: The version of the sharing policy the owner saw when she chose these

descriptionVersion.description: The version of the plain-words category descriptions she saw

level.description: The level to hold, or null to revoke

childId.description: Required exactly when the category is child

get.description: The actor id, the profile summary, guardianships, active grants held and the session expiry: every client bootstraps from this one call.

post.summary: Invite someone into the actor's household
post.description: Mints a single-use token bound to the invitee's email, stores only its hash with a 72 hour expiry, and sends the link by mail. The actor's own household is created on the first invitation, unless she already belongs to a household she does not own (409 member_of_another_household). Needs a fresh authentication and an Idempotency-Key.

put.summary: Set what one person may see
put.description: Sets the level of each listed category for the person, creating, changing or revoking grants; categories not listed stay as they are. The private journal cannot be named. A child grant names the child and needs the actor to be its guardian. Needs a fresh authentication.
